selection_rule: All six previously reserved further-development scenarios, fixed before their public instructions were read; variant 1 and original order; no output-based substitutions.
server_lease_basis: Identical single-slot 64K M3 server restarted only after all P21 generations completed. Eight-hour bounded lease; verify actual supervisor before six tasks. Required remaining time 12060 seconds.
scope: Six previously reserved development scenarios, one seed each, P11/P18 full-history baseline. Natural failure discovery; no new-method efficacy or independent confirmation claim.
discovery_policy: Initially api_docs and supervisor schemas. A requested app description exposes that public app; individual API documentation exposes that API. New schemas apply on the next model response. No answer-based selection or silent top-k pruning.
interpretation: Same model, public tool access, executor prompt, history rendering, seed and per-trial budgets as P11.
All six previously reserved development scenarios retained, including successes. No hidden solution, target list or difficulty label supplied.
No memory generation or P17 contract update is used in this full-history arm.
AppWorld is isolated simulation only; public instructions do not authorize real financial, file or account actions.
No concurrent heavy inference with P21. Final evaluation stays separate and is never supplied to later model requests.
Boundary DB/harness snapshots do not claim full process/RNG/cache restoration.
P21 export cap 8192 was a separate offline sensitivity check. Keep 4096 per-call output here to match P11/P18 baseline; do not silently retune on the export result.
history_representation: Append-only public assistant content/calls and tool observations; no reasoning replay. Same archive page size. Invalid argument turns use text fallback preserving raw calls and actual results.
